author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a great day for preserving our games. Two weeks ago one of the largest repository for old games was to be taken down and gone forever, today it seems it's been backed up for everyone to access for the foreseeable future. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Actual Good News Finally...
